theorems.name: Submission.dph_iprod_slice_covector_norm_le
theorems.statement: (∀ (m k : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Eucl (m + 1)) (k + 1)) (γ' : Covector (Eucl m) k), (∀ v : Fin k → Eucl m, γ' v = γ (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → covectorEuclideanNorm γ' ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ) ∧ (∀ (m q : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Eucl (m + 1)) q) (γ' : Covector (Eucl m) q), (∀ v : Fin q → Eucl m, γ' v = γ (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → covectorEuclideanNorm γ' ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Eucl P) n), covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ Real.sqrt ((P : ℝ) ^ n) * ‖α‖)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
